description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector class, which manages collection, structuring, and formatting of HTML validation errors for the HTML Purifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector
classes.description: Manages collection, structuring, and HTML formatting of errors encountered during HTML purification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the error collector with a given context, setting locale and error stacks.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Records an error message with severity, performs substitutions, and structures error data.

methods.name: getRaw
methods.description: Returns the raw error data for custom formatting.

methods.name: getHTMLFormatted
methods.description: Generates an HTML representation of the collected errors, recursively rendering error structures.

methods.name: _renderStruct
methods.description: Recursively renders error structures into HTML strings for display.
